name: House of Pancakes Reptile Rescue (HoPRR)
neighborhoods: Poughkeepsie (Dutchess County, NY) + Lakewood, PA; regional - surrenders drop off in Poughkeepsie or Lakewood
region_note: REPTILES & AMPHIBIANS (turtles/tortoises, lizards, snakes; red-eared sliders a major NYC issue)
notes: Foster-based 501(c)(3) focused on medically fragile / special-needs reptiles other rescues can't resource. Will NOT take any species native to New York (refers those to the DEC rehabber list) or aquatic turtles/leopard geckos/large snakes/sulcata tortoises. Surrender fee $50/animal (as of 2026-01-01); surrenders must be dropped in Poughkeepsie or Lakewood. Regional - flagged as not NYC-local but the nearest dedicated non-turtle reptile rescue.
